row.body: The apartment plan marks the unit occupied, while the key log says the building was empty at the same time. A tenant’s route note ends at the stairwell.
row.title: Cozy unit, no exit note

sidecar.rival_reading: A field crew could use an apartment as a temporary room; the records do not say who held the key.

row.body: opposite route arrows are painted on the dish cloth and folded road map. the older arrow was scraped away beneath fresh road grit.
row.title: missing count beside the dish cloth

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
